KENT FAMILY THANKSGIVING OPEN - NOV. 13-15 - REGISTER NOW

Kent Family Open Chess Tournament
Events > Kent Family Thanksgiving Open 2026
November 13, 2026

Kent Family Thanksgiving Open 2026

Register Now

Event Details

Nov 13, 2026 - Nov 15, 2026

Saint Louis Chess Club

The Saint Louis Chess Club welcomes players to the Kent Family Thanksgiving Open, November 13–15, 2026. Compete in a five-round Swiss with Premiere (Open) and Reserve (U2000) sections and a guaranteed $10,000 prize fund.

Online registration closes Friday, November 13, at 4:30 PM Central. Round 1 begins at 6:30 PM. No onsite registration.

  • Entry fee: $100 per player. Free entry for GMs and IMs.
  • Sections: Premiere (Open), FIDE & US Chess rated. Reserve (U2000), US Chess rated.
  • Time control: G/90; +30-second increment from move 1.
  • Membership: Saint Louis Chess Club membership (or a day pass) and US Chess membership are required.

Our Mission

It is the mission of the Saint Louis Chess Club, an educational organization, to maintain a formal program of instruction to teach the game of chess and to promote and support its educational program through community outreach and local and national partnerships to increase the awareness of the educational value of chess.

Non-Discrimination Policy

The Saint Louis Chess Club does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, ancestry, citizenship, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, disability, and any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws or regulations in administration of its educational policies, admissions policies, scholarship and loan programs, events, programs, or activities.

Policy on Relationships & Interactions with Minors

The integrity of Saint Louis Chess Club’s relationship with minor players is paramount to the Chess Club’s educational mission and success. All individuals employed by or working under the direction or authority of the Saint Louis Chess Club are expected and required to maintain appropriate boundaries and relationships with minors and are strictly prohibited from engaging in sexual misconduct, hazing and harassment.

Reporting Concerns

We encourage anyone with information regarding policy violations or inappropriate conduct involving individuals employed by or working under the direction or authority of the Saint Louis Chess Club, or occurring on Saint Louis Chess Club property or at Saint Louis Chess Club events, to report such concerns to the General Manager, Joy Bray, [email protected] – 314.361.2437 and/or Administrative Director, Tad Middleton, [email protected] -314.361.2437. You may also make a report confidentially, and if you wish, anonymously, through our confidential ethics reporting hotline managed by Navex at (833)221-3624.

Any other concerns may be reported to US Chess Safe Play and/or FIDE Ethics and Disciplinary Commission.
